site.metaTitle: CLEM LTD — Quality Steel Products in Rwanda
site.metaDescription: Since 2015, CLEM LTD supplies quality steel products across Rwanda — steel sheets, door frames, hollow sections, deformed bars, profiles, rovers and gutters. Official representative of Steel & Tube Industries (Uganda). Request a proforma today.

hero.subtext: For over a decade, CLEM LTD has supplied builders, fabricators and traders with dependable steel products — backed by trusted manufacturers across China, Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda.

about.heading: A decade of dependable steel supply in Rwanda.
paragraphs: Founded in 2015 and based in Kigali, CLEM LTD has grown into one of the region's trusted names in steel. We supply a complete range of steel products to contractors, fabricators, hardware retailers and individual builders across the country.

By working directly with established manufacturers in China, Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda, we keep quality consistent and pricing competitive — and we pass that reliability on to the 2,000+ customers who count on us.
As the official representative of Steel and Tube Industries Ltd (Uganda), we bring proven, industry-grade steel to the Rwandan market.
about.partnerText: Authorised representative of Steel and Tube Industries Ltd — Uganda in Rwanda.

products.heading: Our steel product range
products.intro: Quality steel for construction, fabrication and finishing. Found what you need? Request a proforma on any product and we'll respond within 24 hours.

items.name: Steel Sheets
items.description: Flat-rolled steel sheets in a range of gauges for roofing, cladding and general fabrication.

items.name: Door Frames
items.description: Pressed steel door frames — durable, true-to-size and ready for on-site installation.

items.name: Hollow Sections
items.description: Square and rectangular tubing for structural framing, gates, trusses and general fabrication.

items.name: Steel Bars (Deformed)
items.description: Ribbed reinforcement bars (rebar) for concrete structures, foundations and slabs.

items.name: Bottle Profiles
items.description: Specialised steel profiles used in window and door manufacturing and metal finishing.

items.name: Rovers (Doors & Windows)
items.description: Steel sections engineered for fabricating doors and windows with clean, strong joints.

items.name: Metal Gutters
items.description: Galvanized gutters for durable, leak-free rainwater drainage on homes and commercial roofs.

sourcing.heading: Sourced from trusted manufacturers
sourcing.intro: We import directly from established steel producers across four countries — keeping quality consistent and supply reliable.

proforma.heading: Tell us what you need — we'll send a quote.
proforma.subtext: Fill in the form and our team will prepare a proforma invoice for you. No account needed — your request lands straight in our inbox.

contact.heading: Visit or contact us
contact.intro: We're based in Kigali and ready to help. Reach out by email, phone or stop by.

footer.tagline: Quality steel products supplied across Rwanda since 2015. Official representative of Steel & Tube Industries Ltd (Uganda).
